'''Barret''' (Japanese: '''ブラッド''' ''Brad'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}. He is a member of [[Team Plasma]].

==History==
Barret first appeared with two other grunts looking for {{an|N}} under [[Ghetsis]]'s orders. Barret was able to find N when he used a locator inside his briefcase and deduced the hidden location. With N found, Barret started attacking the Pokémon with {{p|Magnezone}} but [[Anthea and Concordia]]'s {{p|Gardevoir}} and {{p|Gothitelle}} blocked the attacks with {{m|Protect}}. {{Ash}} decided to deal with Barret while {{an|Iris}} and {{an|Cilan}} handled the other two. While [[Cilan's Pansage]] attacked Magnezone, a collision of {{m|Bullet Seed}} and {{m|Magnet Bomb}} caused an explosion. The seeds went flying in which {{AP|Pignite}}'s snout became stuck by one of the stray seeds. With Barret's Magnezone defeated by {{AP|Pikachu}} afterwards, a fog occurred which prevented Barret from seeing anything and allowed Ash and {{ashfr}} to get away. Barret became upset about not being able to capture N and left the forest.

In ''[[BW119|Meowth, Colress and Team Rivalry!]]'', when {{TRT}} hacked into Team Plasma's data, the trio imprisoned Barret, [[Aldith]] and the grunts while they were running off with the data. However, Barret had Magnezone confuse some nearby Pokémon to break them free.

In ''[[BW120|Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!]]'', he battled with [[Cedric Juniper]]'s assistants' Pokémon with Colress's aid.

In ''[[BW121|Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!]]'', he tried to stop {{Ash}} and his Pokémon from saving the others using the ones Colress had managed to control with his machine.

He was arrested alongside [[Ghetsis]], [[Colress]], Aldith and the other Grunts in ''[[BW122|What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!]]'' by [[Looker]], after Ghetsis' plan of using {{p|Reshiram}} failed.

==Character==
Barret, like the other Team Plasma Grunts, is able to follow orders from [[Colress]]. Also, he appeared to be a leader figure similar to [[Aldith]], even going as far to provoke {{Ash}}. Also, he does not like it when someone interferes with his plans and Team Plasma's as evidenced when he encountered Ash and Team Rocket, two different times, and mentioned them to [[Colress]].
